analysis.title: GS TMT TODAY 11.19.26
key_insights: Futures bid up (Nasdaq +200bps, S&P +115bps, Russell +60bps) with risk-on sentiment across Tech/AI assets. Crude is slightly higher (WTI +1%), the 10-year is flat, and gold is down 0.30% to a new low for the year.

After Trump's APEC trip, Xi called the meeting 'positive and constructive.' Both sides agreed to build a 'constructive relationship of strategic stability' and draw up an action plan to stabilize relations despite renewed tensions over US chip curbs.
PANW is up about 10% pre-market (after +10% the prior day into the print) on F1Q results above the Street and a raised FY27 outlook. CRWD, NET, S and OKTA are up 4-6% in sympathy.

PANW F1Q: RPO, revenue and NGS ARR were in line, 4% above and 2% above the Street. EBIT margin was about 140bps above and EPS was 8% above (FactSet). PANW is up 78% YTD, and GS sees incremental drivers for outperformance in 2027.
PANW raised FY27 guidance: RPO to 19.3-20.3% y/y (Street 19.3%), revenue to 26.5-26.9% y/y (Street 23.4%), NGS ARR to 26.1-26.6% y/y (Street 22.3%).

PANW will acquire Applied Compute for an EV of $4.5bn in all stock, targeted to close in 3QFY27. Applied Compute is a platform for post-training and inference of open-weight AI models. PANW targets $1bn ARR exit run rate in 2029 vs about $100mn today, and expects to stand up 100-150 MW of compute at under $3bn cumulative capex through FY30.

GS says PANW now has several ways to attach to token consumption: software firewalls, observability, and Prisma AIRS (2-5% of inference spend). GS industry conversations point to more urgency on security budgets from aging infrastructure, agentic attacks and faster patching cycles, with more wallet share consolidation at PANW.
GOOGL is up about 4% on the release of Gemini 4 Neon. Google says it scores 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at xhigh thinking, #3 overall and just behind larger, slower models.
TTWO is down 3% on continued volatility (+7% the prior day) into the GTA VI launch on 11/19.

BABA fiscal 2Q27 results: revenue growth in line at 10% y/y, adjusted group EBITA up 260% y/y and 6% above GSe. Stock is down about 2-2.5% pre-market, with the call ongoing and focus on future capex and funding.

BABA AI Cloud & Compute revenue grew 53% y/y (in line with GSe, 3ppt above VA consensus) on 67% external revenue growth. EBITA margin was 14.5% vs GSe 12.5% and 11.6% last quarter, implying 23% incremental margins. AI-related product revenue grew at triple digits for the 13th straight quarter.

BABA capex was Rmb50bn (+60% y/y vs +75% last quarter), 20% below GSe. FCF outflow narrowed to Rmb-34.5bn from Rmb-44.7bn a quarter ago. Capital commitments contracted but not yet paid were Rmb62bn at end-Sep 2026. Management targets eventual positive FCF while focusing on ROIC.

BABA AI Labs & Applications revenue growth accelerated to 51% y/y (24% above GSe), with EBITA loss narrowing to Rmb-10.5bn from Rmb-13.9bn. The E-commerce Group's CMR was -5% y/y (+1% like-for-like) and EBITA rose 243% y/y to Rmb38.9bn, both in line with GSe.

TSMC and Samsung have suspended some chip shipments to Chinese customers while they apply for US commerce department licences under new US export controls (FT). Chinese tech companies already face component shortages after a historic jump in memory chip prices and capacity constraints at SMIC.
Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan said Intel signed the first external customer for its 18A chips and did not name the client (CNBC). It is a milestone for Intel's effort to compete with TSMC in foundry.
COHR authorized a share buyback of up to $2B.

AVGO FQ3 preview (Schneider): expects modest upside to guidance. Focus is on management confidence in FY27 guidance, datacenter and customer readiness for FY28 deployments, and competition from MediaTek and others. Expectations are muted on AI spending durability given FY28 land, power and shell constraints, though they have improved with the stock's outperformance over the past week.
AMZN is warning that NYC Intro 518 could add up to $5 per order and force it to consider moving delivery operations outside the city.
Equities are bid on renewed AI sentiment: SMH +3.5% pre-market, DRAM +5%, NVDA +2.5%, neoclouds +6.5%. There was little incremental news overnight.
Most active high-touch names: NVDA, GOOGL, NOW, AVGO, SNAP, DT, AMZN, PATH.

GS research on ASML after a Wilton site visit: strong High NA momentum, deep competitive moat, multiple avenues for output optimisation, strong installed base and upgrades business, and Match Act concerns overdone. Reiterates Buy (on CL).
GS expects a solid SNPS FY4Q print with FY27 guidance reflecting acceleration per the Investor Day framework. It views SNPS and Cadence as uniquely insulated from AI disruption.

Recon Analytics (expert network) sees a healthy wireless ARPU environment in 2027, driven more by perks and picks than backbook price increases. Cable operators are focused on customer satisfaction, and Starlink may start in rural areas.
After investor meetings on 11/17-11/18, GS says conviction increased in the four tenets of its SIRI thesis, detailed in its recent upgrade note. Topics included the CEO transition.
Street actions: UBS upgraded BOX and MDB to Buy. Barclays initiated SNPS at Overweight.

Events 11/19: earnings pre-market from BABA, FUTU, NTES, PDD, Ubisoft, WMG, Walmart, YMM, and post-market from ESTC, GLOB, INTU, KEYS. GS hosts GRND and RELY, and a hardware bus tour (650 Group, SMCI, CSCO, ANET, LITE). MSFT Ignite and the TTWO GTA VI launch are also on 11/19. On 11/20, BSP reports pre-market and MSFT Ignite continues.
